summary: Pratapaditya Pal is a scholar of Indology, Tibetology, and history and archaeology. He earned degrees from the University of Calcutta and the University of Cambridge, later serving as curator at Boston's Museum of Fine Arts and LACMA, and editing Marg.

Praveen Verma is an Indology scholar who earned his Ph.D. from Jawaharlal Nehru University in 1997. He became a Group Leader and Staff Scientist VI at the National Institute of Plant Genome Research in 1998 and an adjunct faculty member at JNU in 2020.

Prayag Raj Sharma is a scholar of Indology and history and archaeology. He served as dean at Tribhuvan University's Centre for Nepal and Asian Studies in 1973, as a professor there (attested 1976-1990), and on the advisory board of Kailash in 1976.
Prayoon Mererk is a scholar in Buddhist studies and philosophy. He completed his doctoral thesis at the University of Delhi in 1985 under the supervision of Margaret Chatterjee and Mahesh Tiwary.
Prem Pahlajrai is a scholar of Indology and linguistics. At the University of Washington, he was attested as a PhD student in 2006 and as Associate Teaching Professor Emeritus of Hindi in 2026.

id: P:Prince Peter of Greece and Denmark
summary: Prince Peter of Greece and Denmark worked in Tibetology and history and archaeology. He earned a Dr.juris from the University of Paris, studied under Bronisław Malinowski at the London School of Economics (Ph.D. 1959), and served in the OSS.

Pritam Saha specializes in philosophy, Sinology, and Indology. He completed a Ph.D. in Chinese Philosophy at East China Normal University in 2025 and became a postdoctoral fellow at Sun Yat-sen University that same year.

Priyanka Basu is an Indologist who completed her B.A. at Bethune College in 2006. She served as a curator at the British Library (2016-2021) and was appointed Lecturer in Performing Arts at King's College London in 2021.

Priyanka Pradeep Salekar works in Indology, linguistics, and computational fields. She earned degrees from the University of Mumbai and Deccan College, and became a PhD researcher and teaching assistant at IIT Bombay in 2021.

Priyanka Sharma is an Indology scholar who earned an M.Phil from Mahatma Gandhi Antarrashtriya Hindi Vishwavidyalaya in 2012. She later served as an assistant professor at Lovely Professional University from 2018 to 2019.

Priyanku Chakraborty is an Indology, Buddhist studies, and history and archaeology scholar who held posts at The Asiatic Society in 2022 and 2026 (as Rajendralal Mitra RF). He conducted doctoral research under Aishwarya Biswas.

Priyavrat Sharma was an Indology and history and archaeology scholar. His career posts included serving as Director of Banaras Hindu University and as Director of its Postgraduate Institute of Indian Medicine.

Prods Oktor Skjærvø is an Iranian and Central Asian studies and linguistics scholar. Educated at Oslo and Mainz, he worked at Mainz and Columbia before serving as Aga Khan Professor of Iranian Studies at Harvard University (~1991-2015).

Prudence R. Myer was a scholar of history, archaeology, Indology, and Buddhist studies who earned her Ph.D. from NYU's Institute of Fine Arts. She held faculty posts at Mount Holyoke College, Tulane University, and UC Santa Barbara.
Przemysław Szczurek is an Indologist who has held positions at Adam Mickiewicz University in Poznań and at the University of Breslau, where he is attested in 2021 as Professor of Indology.

Puji Sulani works in Buddhist studies, religious studies, and history and archaeology. Educated at the State University of Jakarta and the University of Indonesia (Doctoral 2023), Sulani held a post at Sekolah Tinggi Agama Buddha Negeri Sriwijaya in 2009.

Pulinbihari Chakravarti was an Indology and philosophy scholar who studied under Jogendranath Vedantatirtha and Satkari Mookerjee. He served as Curator of Manuscripts at The Asiatic Society, attested in 1951.
Punyavijaya was an Indology and religious studies scholar who studied under Sukhlal Sanghvi. He also founded the Prakrit Text Society.

Purna Harsha Bajracharya is a scholar in history, archaeology, and Buddhist studies. In 1972, he was attested as Chief Research Officer at both the Archaeological Survey of India and the Department of Archaeology.

Purnima Dhavan is an Indology and history and archaeology scholar who studied at the University of Michigan and the University of Virginia. She taught at Bowdoin College and St. John's University before joining the University of Washington faculty in 2005.
